description: Represents a flattened tree-list row with hierarchy metadata.

members.name: HasChildren
members.description: Whether this row has child rows.

members.name: IsExpanded
members.description: Whether this row is currently expanded.

members.name: IsVisible
members.description: Whether this row should be rendered (all ancestors expanded).

members.name: Level
members.description: Zero-based depth level in the tree.

members.name: ParentId
members.description: Identifier of the parent item, or null for root rows.
